specs.title: 粉萝卜小怪
specs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single game animation strip containing TWO frames of ONE enemy species for a paper rabbit-and-carrot jumping game. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its warm flecked paper cutout texture, charcoal wax-crayon outline, fine cream paper rim, friendly small-game illustration quality. Primary request: A round squat rosy pink radish imp, white cream lower belly, short teal leafy crown, two small stubby dark feet, small mitten arms, mischievous charcoal brows and oval black eyes, one tiny tooth. Broad round silhouette ratio 58:52. No wings. Idle left and a tiny squashed stepping pose right. Composition: a wide horizontal transparent sprite strip, exactly two equal cells left and right; one complete character centered in each half, generous transparent padding, an entirely empty transparent vertical gutter at center. Both frames depict the same creature at the same scale, matching colors, same baseline, subtle animation pose change only. Match the stated silhouette ratio within each cell so it reads at the game's small native sprite size. Character must look like a mischievous obstacle, clearly distinct from the cream rabbit hero and golden/orange carrot pickups. Flat 2D crayon paper, no 3D. Actual transparent RGBA background. No panels, boxes, ground, platforms, shadows beneath feet, glow, color overlays, motion swooshes, debris, letters, labels, numbers or watermark. Only the two full creature frames; no extra objects or characters.
